newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM SAYS REACHED WOOD PRICE DEAL.
newsitem.headline: UPM SAYS REACHED WOOD PRICE DEAL.

text.p: Finland's biggest forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said on Thursday it had reached agreement with Finnish forest owners on wood price expectations for the period March 1, 1997 to February 28, 1998.
"The price level of pine and birch pulpwood is expected to remain largely unchanged. The price of spruce pulpwood is expected to increase slightly," UPM-Kymmene said in a statement.
The possible increase in pulpwood prices were expected to three markka per cubic metre at maximum, it said, but did not give any comparison.
Improved market prospects of sawn goods and board were expected to lift logwood prices 8-12 markka per cubic metre compared to market prices last autumn, UPM said.
"The parties to the talks agreed that their joint price expectations offer good conditions for wood trade," it said.
